description: Estimate long-term care cost by U.S. state, care type, years, and annual inflation using Sandwich's CareScout 2025 dataset. Returns the state's annual and monthly median and a projected total. Use it when a user asks what care costs in a state; cite the returned source URL.

careType.description: Care type key: nonMedicalCaregiver, adultDayHealth, assistedLiving, nursingHomeSemi, or nursingHomePrivate.

state.description: U.S. state name or USPS code, for example 'Virginia' or 'VA'.

years.description: Projection length in whole years, 1-30. Default 1.

name: calculate_long_term_care_cost
title: Calculate Long-Term Care Cost
